exceptions.reason: Space Grotesk is the explicit suite design-contract typeface.

Panel source classes are flattened by .tab-content > .panel and ceremony overrides; section rules and table scrollers intentionally run to the content edge. Rendered body copy and dialog fields have separate insets. The audit table edge is a scroll boundary, not text padding.

The standalone static scan pairs dark secondary text with a light panel. The classic theme adapter applies a complete Busnes palette before paint. Live ceremony measurements: light text rgb(24,35,38) on rgb(248,246,240); dark text rgb(242,239,232) on rgb(24,35,38). Existing active-palette checks pass for body, secondary and semantic text across surfaces. This is not an all-theme/control contrast gate.
